observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting that composing a ticket without an explicit email_config_id uses the team's default support channel, and rejects the request if no default exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression test coverage for the fallback behavior when no explicit channel is supplied, relying on the backend's default-channel selection.

observations.behavior: Makes email_config_id optional and nullable, and updates help text to document the fallback behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the serializer to omit the channel ID, supporting the fallback to the team's default support channel.

observations.behavior: Changes the compose implementation to prefer the default support channel when no explicit email_config_id is supplied, and returns a more specific error message if no default exists.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the fallback behavior: if no explicit channel is supplied, the backend searches for a default support channel; otherwise it returns a 400 error with a message indicating the absence of a default.
